boundary_disclosure: A project is assigned to a pilot area when its representative point is covered by the union of that area's official public plan polygons. Campbell Heights includes the South Campbell Heights plan. Overlaps are resolved by precedence: city_centre, then fleetwood, then campbell_heights. Plan polygons are official source features published for public planning purposes; this tool does not approximate them or treat them as legal or survey boundaries.

selection.note: Explicit 5-record public demo selection, captured live 2026-10-06 from the public Development Applications layer for this reference example only. It is not a contractual or City-endorsed selection. All other records are explicitly excluded.
